note: Synthetic model responses for ai.classifyTransaction (phase 8). Each entry is a verbatim model response as the scripted test transport returns it — the shape src/ai validates, not the shape it produces. Keyed by the REDACTED description the transport actually receives (docs/security/security-model.md), which is why account fragments and merchant-embedded numbers appear as [redacted-number]. No real model produced any of these, and nothing here is a proposal about real money.
placeholders: {{person_*}} is substituted with the seeded Person id at test time — fixture ids are stable, database ids are not.

responses.why: A catalogued grocery merchant, unambiguous: the high-confidence, immaterial path that ends at CLASSIFIED.
A restaurant bill may or may not have been split; the model says so rather than guessing, and REVIEW_REQUIRED follows.
A recurring flat utility bill — the household case, high confidence.
A round-number transfer to a known person: the settlement discriminator ADR-0007 added. Always reviewed, whatever the confidence.
